Responsibilities Develop and expand our international business with a

hinged doors Build and maintain long-term relationships with
developers, investors, architects, consulting engineers and general
contractors Utilize and further develop your professional network to

special departments and the project team Coordinate projects till

Experience in project sales or business development within the
international construction industry Experience with data center
construction projects or other mission-critical facilities is highly

ecosystem—including consultants, architects, developers, general
contractors—is considered a strong advantage Strong commercial

Self-motivated, proactive and willing to travel internationally Fluent

construction sectors High level of responsibility with room for

About us European Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (ESMC) is a
joint venture between four technology leaders, TSMC, Bosch, Infineon
and NXP, to establish a state-of-the-art semiconductor fab in the
heart of Europe. ESMC represents our shared commitment to
strengthening the European semiconductor ecosystem. Für unsere
zukünftige Fab in Dresden suchen wir eine/n hochmotivierte/n und
engagierte/n: Equipment Engineer (m/f/d) – Start Date: 1 October
2026 At ESMC, the Equipment Engineer supports the installation,
maintenance, troubleshooting, and optimization of advanced
semiconductor manufacturing equipment in a cleanroom environment. As
part of a high-volume 24/7 fab operation, the role focuses on ensuring
tool performance, improving uptime, reducing defects, and supporting
stable production. The position requires openness to scheduled and
occasional shift work, on call duty, includes an initial induction and
training period in Dresden of one month, followed by one year of
on-the-job training in Taiwan. If you are interested in advancing your
career in semiconductor manufacturing, learning from one of the
world’s leading semiconductor companies, and joining an
international and diverse team on a unique learning journey, apply now
with your English CV. Tasks 1. Maintain equipment performance in a
cleanroom environment to support stable, high-quality production. 2.
Handle on-duty tasks and perform fundamental alarm troubleshooting. 3.
Install and qualify new tool sets according to project plans and
schedules. 4. Identify root causes and solve critical equipment
issues. 5. Improve tool uptime and availability while driving defect
reduction. 6. Identify and pursue opportunities for hardware
capability enhancement. 7. Build defense and monitoring systems to
prevent equipment failures and performance loss. 8. Manage vendor
relationships and act as module liaison with facilities, vendors, and
manufacturing shift personnel. 9. Support scheduled night shifts,
evening shifts, weekend work, on-duty assignments, and on-call duties
as required in a 24/7 high-volume manufacturing environment. Profile

1. Legally eligible to work in Germany. 2. Available for approximately
one year of on-the-job training in Taiwan. 3. Open for scheduled and
occasional shift work, on call duty. 4. Degree in electronics,
electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, mechanics,
mechatronics, material engineering, or an equivalent field. 5.
Practical experience in a mechanical or equipment-related field. 6.
Understanding of technical documentation and schematics. 7. Knowledge
of semiconductor manufacturing is a plus. 8. Fluent in English with
good command of German. 9. Hands-on working attitude with an open
mindset. 10. Strong communication and interpersonal skills. 11. Able
to perform physical work on tools in a cleanroom environment.
Important Candidate Information: Start Date: This role is planned to
commence on October 1, 2026, in Dresden. Depending on your needs and
timeline preferences, January 1, 2027, can be considered as an
alternative start date. Onboarding and International Training: The
first month of your employment will be spent in Dresden. Following

company dormitories. Role Requirements and Expectations: This is a

organization and ways of working. Candidates should be comfortable in

strong growth mindset, a positive attitude, and a long-term

About us European Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (ESMC) is a
joint venture between four technology leaders, TSMC, Bosch, Infineon
and NXP, to establish a state-of-the-art semiconductor fab in the
heart of Europe. ESMC represents our shared commitment to
strengthening the European semiconductor ecosystem. To help us build
the foundation of our future fab in Dresden, we are looking for a
highly motivated and passionate (m/f/d): Senior Equipment Hook-Up
Engineer As a Senior Equipment Hook-Up Engineer, you will be
coordinating all hook-up activities from planning, construction, and
commissioning of faculty media supplies (gases, chemicals, exhaust
air, ultra-pure water, wastewater, electricity) from the base build
supply connection to the process equipment at our new state-of-the-art
semiconductor fab in Dresden. Your role will ensure system safety,
reliability, efficiency, and compliance while driving continuous
improvement and innovation. You will collaborate with internal teams
and external service providers. Tasks New challenges: Become part of
the facility team to build ESMC's 300mm semiconductor fab. System
Ownership & Optimization: Develop and manage detailed schedules for
equipment hookups, coordinating with equipment vendors, construction
teams, contract vendor management, and facility engineers to ensure
seamless integration in compliance with environmental and safety
regulations. Technical Expertise: Review and approve hookup designs
and engineering plans, ensuring compliance with industry standards and
project specifications. Experience in electrical, process colling
water, ultra-pure water, Gas & Chemical, and other Plastic utility
systems. Data-Driven Decision Making: Monitor and report on the
progress of hookup activities to senior management, addressing any
issues or delays proactively. Project Involvement: Support system
design, construction, and commissioning for new facility installations
and upgrades. Continuous Improvement & Cost Optimization: Plan,
coordinate, and execute strategies to accelerate hookup progress.
Identify opportunities for cost savings, reliability improvements, and
integration of best practices. Collaboration: Lead a team of
technicians and contractors, providing guidance, training, and
performance evaluations. Communicate with cross function engineers or
venders. Profile Job Qualifications: Qualifications and Education:
Degree in Electrical, Chemical, Mechanical or Automation Engineering
or a related field Must have experience: 10+ years of experience in
equipment hookup or facility engineering within the semiconductor
industry. Proven track record in managing large-scale construction or
installation projects. Familiarity with semiconductor fabrication
processes and equipment. Language Skills: Fluent German and English
language skills. Professional Skills: Proficient with Microsoft
Office, discipline-specific software (i.e., AutoCAD, Revit, etc.).
Personal Attributes: Strong analytical thinking and highly effective
interpersonal and communication skills when interacting with others.
Location: Dresden, Germany. What we offer Each journey starts with a
first step. Joining ESMC at this early stage will provide you with the
unique opportunity to actively shape the future of the fab in Dresden,
boost your career and unlock your potential. Work in a fast paced,
international startup environment while at the same time having access
to the experience, talent, and resources of the largest and most
advanced semiconductor manufacturer in the world, TSMC. At ESMC, we
create an inclusive environment to inspire passion and enable the best
in YOU. It is the policy of ESMC to provide equal employment
opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, ethnic and
national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability,
race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender
identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status,
status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other
characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. Contact
Please apply with English resume

About us Die European Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (ESMC) GmbH
ist das Joint Venture von TSMC, Bosch, Infineon und NXP. Erstmals
errichtet der weltweite Technologieführer TSMC eine Halbleiterfabrik
im Herzen Europas, die kleinste Fertigungstechnologien für
Halbleiterprodukte der nächsten Generation bietet. ESMC steht für
das gemeinsame Engagement zur Stärkung des europäischen
Halbleiter-Ökosystems. Für unsere zukünftige Fab in Dresden suchen
wir eine/n hochmotivierte/n und engagierte/n: Quality Management &
Document Control Engineer (m/f/d) Are you ready to shape the quality
standards of a state-of-the-art semiconductor fab from the ground up?
As a Quality Management & Document Control Engineer (m/f/d) at ESMC,
you will bridge the gap between our Taiwanese headquarters and our
brand-new greenfield facility in Dresden. Starting on January 2027,
you will own the Document Control System, ensure compliance with
international quality standards, and coordinate internal, customer,
and third-party audits. By running trainings and cross-departmental
programs, you will champion a proactive quality culture across the
Fab. If you are a detail-oriented professional with initial QA
experience looking to make a lasting impact on Europe’s
semiconductor ecosystem, we want you on our team! Tasks System
Ownership: Administer and maintain the site-wide Document Control
System (DCS) to guarantee database integrity, document effectiveness,
and smooth annual document review processes. Audit Management:
Independently plan, execute, and follow up on internal quality audits,
customer audits, and third-party quality system certifications.
Continuous Improvement: Track and drive the implementation of
corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs) resulting from audits and
quality reviews. Promote Quality Culture: Collaborate with the Fab
engineering and manufacturing teams to develop and host
quality-related training sessions, workshops, and symposiums. HQ
Collaboration: Leverage resources, documentation standards, and best
practices from our headquarters to build a reliable local quality
framework. Regulatory Compliance: Ensure all document management and
quality processes comply with German/European regulations, customer
requirements, and standard quality frameworks. Profile Must-Have:
Education: Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in Engineering, Natural
Sciences, Quality & Reliability, or a related technical field.
Experience: 1 to 3 years of professional experience in the
semiconductor, automotive, or highly regulated electronics
manufacturing industries with a focus on Quality Systems (QS) or
Quality Assurance (QA). Methodology & Tools: Solid familiarity with
standard Quality Control tools, 8D problem-solving methodologies, and
core automotive quality tools (such as SPC, MSA, FMEA, APQP, PPAP).
Languages: Fluency in English (written and spoken) for daily
international collaboration. Working Style: Highly organized,
detail-oriented, and resilient under pressure in a fast-paced
environment. Nice-to-Have: Initial experience or certified
qualification as an auditor (e.g., ISO 9001, IATF 16949, or VDA 6.3).
Basic programming/querying skills in SQL (Structured Query Language)
for quality data extraction. Familiarity with the local German
business ecosystem and manufacturing regulations. Basic conversational
skills in German and/or Mandarin. We offer Help build a completely new
semiconductor manufacturing site in Europe. Work in a highly
international environment with colleagues across Europe, Taiwan and
the US. Shape processes instead of maintaining existing structures.
Participate in global projects and cross-functional collaboration.
International onboarding including approximately 9-12 months of
training in Taiwan. Additional contact details Please apply with your
English resume.

jobs.occupation: PhD student (f/m/d) in the field of chemistry/biochemistry (Chemiker/in)
jobs.employer_name: DWI Leibniz-Institut für Interaktive Materialien e.V.
jobs.description:
About usThe DWI – Leibniz-Institute for Interactive Materials is a federal and state funded research institute of the Leibniz Association based on the Melaten Campus of RWTH Aachen University. International young and experienced scientists from various disciplines develop interactive materials based on the principles of nature. It is a location at which people with different talents, experiences and skills work together, in order to learn from one another and generate new knowledge and new methods to create a better quality of life in our world.
DWI offers you a wide range of possibilities to develop further both professionally and personally in an interdisciplinary setting.
PositionDWI invites applications for a position as

PhD student (f/m/d) in the field of chemistry/biochemistry We are looking for a motivated and team-oriented PhD student starting as soon as possible in the research group of Dr. Laura Heinen.

Do you want to shape the next generation of sustainable and biocompatible smart soft polymer materials? Do you want to be part of a stimulating and supportive research environment and receive high-level training throughout your doctoral studies?

We offer a position in a tandem project of the DFG-funded graduate school Adaptive Soft Matter Through Programming Colloidal Gels with Biological Building Blocks (EMERGE; https://www.emerge.rwth-aachen.de/go/id/btvvkb/lidx/1) to develop compartmentalized polysaccharide microgels with programmed degradation for multi-step drug release.

Degradability is an essential property of sustainable polymer materials, especially for agricultural or biomedical applications. The degradation process is tightly connected to important material functions like chemical stability, mechanical strength, the hierarchical architecture and the release of active ingredients. Polysaccharides can be considered as alternatives to synthetic polymers to design microgel particles with programmed enzymatic degradation and high biocompatibility. However, to advance such microgels to superior self-immolative and on-demand drug-release carriers there is a need to embed further functionalities e.g. internally programmed, sustained or temporally administered release of multiple or incompatible drugs.
The Heinen lab pursues an interdisciplinary research approach combining expertise from systems chemistry, synthetic biology and soft matter science to engineer active and life-like soft materials with hierarchical length and time scales.

The DWI – Leibniz Institute for Interactive Materials is equipped with state-of-the art infrastructure to allow top-notch interdisciplinary research at one place and is closely intertwined with RWTH Aachen University.
Your tasksYou will be part of the DFG-funded graduate school Adaptive Soft Matter Through Programming Colloidal Gels with Biological Building Blocks (EMERGE). In project B1 - Programmable drug-release from multicompartment microgel drug carrier systems - your task will be to introduce self-instructed and programmed degradation into microgels by stepwise activation of internal sub-compartments. You will synthesize biodegradable and compartmentalized microgels and establish enzymatic assays to release active ingredients and control the degradation of the microgels. You will apply various microscopy techniques and spectroscopic assays to analyze in detail the morphology of the microgel particles and the release profiles during degradation.

The successful applicant must be accepted as a Natural Sciences (Dr. rer. nat.) candidate at RWTH Aachen University.

Your profile
• You have quickly and very successfully completed your Master studies at a university in the field of e.g., chemistry, biochemistry, biotechnology, or comparable study programs

Ideally, you have already gained previous experience in basic polymer synthesis and/or biochemical enzymatic assays and reaction kinetics. You are creative, curious and team-oriented. You are communicative, open-minded and persistent. You have an accurate and independent work method and you love challenges.
• You are fluent in written and spoken English. You intend to obtain a doctorate (Natural Sciences (Dr. rer. Nat.)) on a challenging interdisciplinary topic.

YOUR SHOES TO FILL:

YOUR WALK OF LIFE:

- Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and hands-on experience using service management and ticketing systems.

- Familiarity with compliance, risk, and control frameworks such as SOX, ISO, ITGC, or NIST is a plus.
- Strong analytical and organizational skills, with the ability to create and maintain clear, structured, and auditable documentation.
- Excellent communication and collaboration skills when working with business stakeholders, audit teams, and IT colleagues.
- Professional proficiency in both English and German (minimum B2 level); relevant certifications such as Microsoft SC-300, ITIL, CISA, or CISM are considered a plus.
